basic_details.job_title: CCS HAU Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar has one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post in the project C(b) PB-185-ICAR, "Mission for Cotton Productivity Kapas Kanti". The post pays Rs. 37000/- + HRA (fixed/consolidated) and runs up to 31.3.2027 (likely to continue). Candidates need a Master degree with 60% in Genetics & Plant Breeding, Agronomy, Soil Science, Nematology or Plant Pathology. Applications on plain paper must be received in the department office by 10:00 A.M. on 20 November 2026, and the interview is on 21 November 2026 at 9:30 A.M.

how_to_apply: Applications are invited on plain paper. The notice attaches an application format as Annexure-A ("Application form for the post of SRF/YP-II and YP-I").
Prepare the application in the Annexure-A format, writing "Senior Research Fellow" against "Application for the position of".
Fill in personal details, educational qualifications (Matriculation to Ph.D), NET status, computer knowledge, experience and publications, as the form asks.
Paste an attested passport size photograph in the space provided.
Attach a No objection certificate from your present employer, if applicable.
Sign the declaration with date and place.

Make sure the complete application is received in the office of the Professor & Head (Genetics & Plant Breeding), Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar by 10:00 A.M. on 20 November 2026.
No application received after this time will be entertained for any reason. The notice does not mention the mode of sending (post or by hand).
important_instructions: The selected candidate must produce a medical certificate of fitness from the CMO of the University at the time of joining. The selected candidate must report for duty within 10 days of issue of the appointment order; otherwise the appointment will be treated as cancelled and may be offered to another selected candidate. An agreement on Non judicial Stamped paper of Rs. 15/- must be executed before joining the post of SRF. In the declaration, the candidate agrees that candidature or appointment may be cancelled without notice if any information is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or ineligibility is detected before or after interview/selection. The notice has been forwarded to the Divisional Employment Exchange, Mini Secretariat, Hisar and to the Additional Director Students Counseling & Placement, CCS HAU, and is to be uploaded on the HAU website.

content_sections.heading: About CCS HAU Senior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: The SRF post sits in the Cotton Section of the Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding at CCS HAU, Hisar, a university in Hisar. It serves the project C(b) PB-185-ICAR, "Mission for Cotton Productivity Kapas Kanti". The Principal Investigator / Nodal Officer is Dr. Karmal Singh Malik, Head, Cotton Section cum Nodal Officer, and the notice is issued by the Professor & Head (Genetics & Plant Breeding).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Master degree with 60% in the discipline of Genetics & Plant Breeding/Agronomy/Soil Science/Nematology/Plant Pathology. The post's discipline is listed as Genetics & Plant Breeding. Age limit: the minimum age is 21 years and the maximum 45 years on the last date of submission of application for selection. A relaxation of 3 years on the maximum age limit is given to SC/BC etc. candidates. The application form (Annexure-A) also asks whether the candidate is NET qualified, for knowledge of computer (certificate, diploma or degree), work experience, publications and a brief note on how the candidate can contribute to the project. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 37000/- plus HRA, fixed/consolidated. TA/DA during service will be payable as per rules of the University, but no TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. The post runs up to 31.3.2027 and is "likely to continue". The appointment will be co-terminus with the project. If work and conduct are not found satisfactory, services can be terminated at any time after giving due opportunity of being heard. A selected candidate who wants to leave can do so after giving one month's notice in writing to the University. Services are liable to be terminated at any time, without assigning any reason, if the funding agency does not release funds for the project. The SRF will not be treated as a regular employee of the University and will not be entitled to CPF/GPF or other benefits of regular employees. On completion of the project, the SRF will stand relieved; the University/department will not be responsible for adjustment on any other post, as there is no equivalent post in the same project/scheme.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCS HAU Senior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Applications are invited on plain paper. The notice attaches an application format as Annexure-A ("Application form for the post of SRF/YP-II and YP-I"). Prepare the application in the Annexure-A format, writing "Senior Research Fellow" against "Application for the position of". Fill in personal details, educational qualifications (Matriculation to Ph.D), NET status, computer knowledge, experience and publications, as the form asks. Paste an attested passport size photograph in the space provided. Attach a No objection certificate from your present employer, if applicable. Sign the declaration with date and place. Make sure the complete application is received in the office of the Professor & Head (Genetics & Plant Breeding), Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar by 10:00 A.M. on 20 November 2026. No application received after this time will be entertained for any reason. The notice does not mention the mode of sending (post or by hand).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview will be held on 21 November 2026 at 9:30 A.M. in the office of the Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. No separate letter for interview will be issued. Candidates must produce or show original certificates at the interview and should also bring certified true copies or original certificates to be submitted to the University.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CCS HAU Recruitment 2026 for SRF?
faq.answer: There is one Senior Research Fellow post in the Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CCS HAU SRF post?
faq.answer: The complete application must be received in the department office by 10:00 A.M. on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CCS HAU SRF post?
faq.answer: A Master degree with 60% in the discipline of Genetics & Plant Breeding/Agronomy/Soil Science/Nematology/Plant Pathology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CCS HAU SRF post?
faq.answer: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years on the last date of submission of application, with 3 years' relaxation on the maximum age for SC/BC etc. candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CCS HAU Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37000/- plus HRA, fixed/consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the SRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to Rs. 37000/-; TA/DA is payable as per University rules, but not for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the CCS HAU SRF post?
faq.answer: Apply on plain paper in the Annexure-A format with an attested passport size photograph, so that it reaches the office of the Professor & Head (Genetics & Plant Breeding), CCS HAU, Hisar by 10:00 A.M. on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the CCS HAU SRF interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 21 November 2026 at 9:30 A.M. in the office of the Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar; no separate interview letter will be issued.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CCS HAU SRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is co-terminus with the project, runs up to 31.3.2027 (likely to continue), and the SRF will not be treated as a regular employee of the University.
